body: [color=#00ff00]Ambition[/color] — feature scope. More = higher score ceiling.
[color=#ffff00]Instability[/color] — jank level. Tag overlaps add it; Fix Bugs costs Soul.
[color=#ff7fff]Soul[/color] — creative integrity. Dev logs +1 / Fix Bugs −3. Cap: 15.
Otherwise: Legendary Jank, Cult Classic, Surprise Hit, Prestige Collapse, or Financial Catastrophe.
• Tag overlaps trigger interactions (see event feed).
• Ship different card combos to unlock more.
